headline: Jatin Gedia recommends JSW Infra and Varroc, warns on PowerGrid
hook: Analyst shifts stance on three key stocks
summary: Technical analyst Jatin Gedia has issued a bullish outlook for JSW Infrastructure and Varroc Engineering. Conversely, he has flagged caution regarding PowerGrid Corporation. These recommendations are based on technical chart analysis. Retail investors holding these stocks may see increased volatility following these analyst notes.
why_it_matters: Analyst sentiment may trigger short-term price fluctuations in these stocks.
winners_losers: JSW Infra, Varroc gain / PowerGrid hurt

headline: Bonanza Securities recommends Sona BLW and JSW Infra
hook: Technical breakout signals for three specific stocks
summary: Technical analyst Kunal Kamble of Bonanza Securities has identified three stock ideas for traders. Sona BLW has broken out of a falling channel that constrained its price throughout August and September. The report provides specific technical levels for investors to monitor for these stocks.
why_it_matters: Traders may find short-term entry points based on these technical patterns.
